German Seasons Vocabulary: A1 Practice with Answers

Learn Frühling, Sommer, Herbst and Winter in German seasonal sentences. Practise articles and im with translations and explained vocabulary exercises.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Vocabulary and usage

The four seasons are der Frühling, der Sommer, der Herbst and der Winter. Use im for in a season: im Frühling. All four names are masculine. Seasonal descriptions depend on location, so examples about leaves or snow describe particular scenes rather than universal conditions.

Common mistake to avoid

English spring has several meanings. Frühling is the season; it is not the word for a mechanical spring or a water source.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Im Frühling blüht unser Kirschbaum.Our cherry tree blossoms in spring.
Worked example 2Im Sommer sitzen wir lange draußen.In summer we sit outside for a long time.
Worked example 3Im Herbst sammeln die Kinder bunte Blätter.In autumn the children collect colourful leaves.
Worked example 4Im Winter wird es hier früh dunkel.In winter it gets dark early here.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Frühling · Herbst · Sommer · Winter

Question 1. Nach dem Winter beginnt der ___. (spring)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Frühling

Frühling names the season following winter.

Question 2. Juli ist hier ein Monat im ___. (summer)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Sommer

Sommer is the season meant in this local example.

Question 3. Nach dem Sommer kommt der ___. (autumn)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Herbst

Herbst means autumn or fall.

Question 4. Wir besuchen die Familie im ___. (winter)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Winter

Im Winter is the standard prepositional expression.

Use it in your own sentence

Name a season you like and a season that is cold.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich mag den Frühling. Im Winter ist es kalt.

Check your wording: Frühling is masculine; im Winter is a seasonal time phrase.

What to practise next

Recall the words without the bank. Use nouns with their articles and verbs with their usual sentence patterns, then write a new context.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
